result.summary: The street environment is characterized by poor pavement quality and a lack of continuous pedestrian infrastructure, with a missing sidewalk on the right side. The presence of blank industrial frontages and the absence of traffic calming or marked crossings create a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved walkway, forcing pedestrians to walk on uneven dirt or in the roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway and existing sidewalk surfaces are cracked and uneven, creating significant trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the roadway and left-side walkway

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: Long stretches of blank walls on the left side reduce natural surveillance and create a desolate pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repave the roadway and existing sidewalk to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Street Lighting and Greening
interventions.description: Enhance pedestrian-scale lighting and introduce street trees to improve visibility, comfort, and the overall quality of the walking environment.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a severely degraded sidewalk with significant cracking and uneven surfaces. A vehicle is parked across a driveway or alleyway entrance, obstructing the continuous pedestrian path and forcing users onto uneven ground.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Pavement
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is heavily cracked, uneven, and crumbling, creating a significant trip hazard for all pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and mid-ground walkway area on the left and center.

hazards.name: Walkway Obstruction
hazards.description: A silver van is parked across the driveway/alley entrance, blocking the continuous pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, between the two main building structures.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Full repaving of the sidewalk to provide a smooth, level, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Clear Path Delineation
interventions.description: Use pavement markings or signage to ensure the pedestrian path remains clear of parked vehicles at driveway crossings.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by narrow, poorly maintained sidewalks with significant weed growth and utility pole obstructions. The lack of marked crossings, traffic calming, or pedestrian-scale lighting creates a streetscape that prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety and comfort.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Utility poles are located directly in the narrow walking path, forcing pedestrians to maneuver around them.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street in the foreground

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Condition
hazards.description: Significant weed growth and cracked pavement create tripping hazards and reduce the effective width of the walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street, particularly the left foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or curb ramps visible at the approaching intersection, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Repair the damaged sidewalk surfaces and widen them to meet ADA standards, providing a clear, unobstructed path.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at the intersection to provide safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide but severely degraded sidewalk adjacent to an industrial building with a long blank frontage. A large roll-up garage door creates a vehicle conflict point across the walkway, and the area lacks basic amenities like lighting, trees, or buffers.

hazards.name: Uneven Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and degraded sidewalk surface creates trip hazards.

hazards.name: Vehicle Conflict Point
hazards.description: Large garage door indicates frequent vehicle crossing of the sidewalk without markings.

hazards.name: Lack of Surveillance
hazards.description: Blank wall frontage reduces natural surveillance and pedestrian comfort.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the sidewalk to provide a level and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Driveway Delineation
interventions.description: Use paint or different materials to clearly mark the vehicle crossing zone.
